title: MiniMax H3 serverless worker output (h3-serverless/v1.1)
description: Result of one job: the generated video (exactly one of video or video_url) and the measured telemetry.

video.description: Base64-encoded video for small results (see OUTPUT_INLINE_MAX_MB / OUTPUT_INLINE_BUDGET_MB).

video_url.description: Presigned HTTP(S) URL for large results uploaded to S3-compatible storage (see S3_* and OUTPUT_URL_TTL_SECONDS).

telemetry.description: Execution-fact telemetry. The required fields below are the minimum; additional v1.1 fields are documented in contract/worker-contract.md.

gpu_cc.description: Compute capability of the GPU that ran the job (torch.cuda).

gpu_class.description: GPU class reported by torch.cuda, for example RTX PRO 6000 or RTX 5090.

sol_called.description: Whether a Sol-H3 node was present in the executed graph.

sol_backend.description: Sol-H3 runtime identifier; present when sol_called is true.

steps.description: Sampler steps read from the executed graph.

lora_hash.description: sha256 of the LoRA file on the model volume.

lora_name.description: LoRA file name from the executed graph.

lora_applied.description: Whether a LoRA loader node was present in the executed graph.

mode.description: H3 conditioning mode read from the executed graph: FL2VA or Ref2VA.

orientation.description: Video orientation measured with ffprobe: 16:9 or 9:16.

pip.description: Whether a picture-in-picture node was present in the executed graph.

visible_frames.description: Number of video frames measured with ffprobe.

audio.description: Whether the output file has an audio stream (ffprobe).

cache.description: Conditioning-cache fact; miss when the optional cache package is not used by the graph.

seconds.description: Measured wall-clock seconds from graph submit to history completion.

continuation_nodes.description: Whether guided-continuation nodes were present in the executed graph.

cold_start_ms.description: Process start to ComfyUI ready, measured on the first generation job of the worker.
